name: eva
description: Eva - Telegram AI companion with pluggable LLM providers, self-learning memory and a real personality
//optionalDependencies: playwright is only used by the browser tool, which is off by default (tools.browser). In `dependencies` it made every install pull ~150 MB of Chromium for a tool nobody asked for. Optional means `npm i -g` stays small, and `npm i playwright` enables it for whoever wants it. The browser tool says exactly what to install when it is missing.
//prepare: The install promise is `npm i -g github:Jzen86/eva` and then it runs. That only works because npm builds a git dependency — it clones, installs devDependencies, and runs `prepare`. Without this script the clone arrives with no dist/, the `bin` entry points at a file that was never created, and the install fails at the first command with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Found on a real server install, where `tsup` was present and nobody had run a build. Do not `npm ci --omit=optional` to install this: tsup's own platform binary is an optional dependency, so omitting optional breaks the build this script runs.
